competing_explanation: The original failure may be a bounded CUDA repeatability effect, an intermediate unexplained discrepancy, a material asset or dtype mismatch, or a one-off event that cannot be reproduced from the saved arrays; action replay separates numerical difference from decision impact.
controls: GitHub-main parent closeout, conclusion, summary, gate summary, selection freeze, raw inventory and inventory verification identities
complete current 745-file and upstream 10285-file cloud inventory rehash
saved current ensemble versus saved three-seed mean consistency for utility and risk
strict exceedance counts at 1e-6, 1e-5 and 1e-4 by element, cell, scene and file
finite-element p50, p90, p95, p99, p99.9 and maximum errors separately for utility and risk
maximizing cell, fold, hashed scene, action, row, column, dtype, current/upstream file SHA and three checkpoint SHAs
current-versus-saved, upstream-versus-saved and current-versus-upstream selected-action replay
weighted-q selected-area risk and raw-utility difference checks
cloud-only per-scene by-cell diagnostics and compact raw diagnostic inventory
disabled_actions: no probability calibration or candidate reselection
no confirmation, canary, locked-test, or cross-domain access
no parent terminal rewrite or retroactive qualification

gates.reference: all parent compact artifacts and both receipt-bound raw workspace inventories match their frozen identities
exact 600-scene by 9-cell utility/risk census, five folds, 600 selected-action replays, and one cloud diagnostic per scene

favorable requires max in (1e-6,1e-5], saved-seed consistency <=1e-6, finite float32 shape identity, and zero selected-action or terminal-gate changes; unfavorable requires max >1e-4, nonfinite/shape/dtype failure, saved-seed inconsistency >1e-6, or any selected-action change; all other values are indeterminate
maximum Wilson distance for scene mismatch prevalence under the frozen two-channel critical value

fixed_factors: the parent receipt, route commit, selection freeze SHA, selected R0_L1 weighted-q/raw/setwise/cap-0.01 candidate, thresholds, gates, and data roles remain frozen
both cloud raw workspaces are fully rehashed against their archived inventories before comparison
comparison is at the saved ensemble level because upstream raw files do not contain single-seed predictions
current saved ensembles are separately compared with the mean of their three saved seed arrays
all differences are computed on CPU by NumPy float64 subtraction from saved float32 arrays; their production source is CUDA sm89
the frozen selected action map is replayed from current and upstream R0_L1 raw utility and weighted-q risk using the upstream frozen scene-cache tile areas
the candidate selection is not rerun and calibration predictions are not read; the parent selection freeze predates its formal OOF array parse
original-clear scenes are the only independent units; cells, files, tiles, actions, and elements never increase n
confirmation, canary, locked-test, NH-Haze, ITS, OTS, images, targets, model inference, and training remain out of scope
intervention.matched_budget: all 600 OOF original-clear scenes, all nine cells, both utility and risk channels, and the exact corresponding fold-specific three-checkpoint identities
intervention.primary_variable: absolute difference between each saved qualification ensemble utility/risk array and its receipt-bound upstream factorial ensemble array
intervention.reference: the upstream saved float32 ensemble utility/risk arrays that were the parent qualification reconstruction target

primary_estimand.aggregation: prevalence over 600 original-clear scenes where any saved ensemble element across nine cells and two metrics strictly exceeds 1e-6

question: Is the parent raw-prediction reconstruction failure a bounded decision-invariant numerical discrepancy rather than a material saved-prediction identity failure?
